findings.title: Full API Requires Zero Authentication
findings.remediation: Add JWT or API-key authentication middleware in app.ts applied before all route groups. Use express-jwt or passport-jwt. Protect /metrics with a bearer token or separate internal port.

findings.title: Fast-Track Override Bypasses Entire State Machine
findings.remediation: Remove overrideRoute from the public API entirely, or gate it behind a server-side role check (e.g., role: admin) in the route middleware layer before the classifyRoute() service call.

findings.title: Intake Webhook Enum Injection and No Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Apply enum validation (Object.values(WorkItemType).includes(body.type)) to both intake endpoints. Add HMAC-SHA256 signature verification middleware using process.env.ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Reject unsigned requests with 401.

findings.title: Cascade Dispatch via Unauthenticated Blocker Rejection
findings.remediation: onItemResolved() should require explicit re-approval before auto-dispatching, or emit a high-severity audit event. The reject endpoint must be protected by authentication (see MERGED-001).

findings.title: Unbounded Pagination Enables Full Dataset Enumeration
findings.remediation: const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 20, 1), 100); Apply to both workItems and dashboard activity routes.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Blocker Causes Permanent Dispatch Denial-of-Service
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, cascade-remove stale dependency links. Alternatively, treat findById() === undefined as resolved in computeHasUnresolvedBlockers().

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Unauthenticated Information Disclosure
findings.remediation: Bind /metrics to a separate internal-only port (e.g., 9090) bound to 127.0.0.1. If not possible, add a static bearer-token check via an environment variable.

findings.title: No Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
findings.remediation: Define roles (operator, reviewer, admin) in JWT claims. Add authorize(role) middleware to each route group. Apply least-privilege: GET to all authenticated; state-transitions to reviewer+; dispatch to admin only.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers (Missing Helmet)
findings.remediation: npm install helmet; add app.use(helmet()) as the first middleware in app.ts. One line, immediate win.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit; apply global limiter (100 req/min per IP) and stricter limiter on intake routes (10 req/min per IP).

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Log Events
findings.remediation: Create audit.ts module emitting structured JSON lines with event, actorId, resourceId, outcome, and timestamp. Call from every state-transition, list endpoint, auth handler, and access-denied path.

findings.title: Assessment Pod Hard-Rejects Items That Need Clarification
frameworks: OWASP Top 10 A08 (Software and Data Integrity)
findings.remediation: Add a third branch in runAssessmentPod(): if (verdict === NeedsClarification) { targetStatus = WorkItemStatus.NeedsClarification; }. Add NeedsClarification as a valid state with a transition back to proposed.

findings.title: Stored Unsanitized Payloads in Audit Change History
findings.remediation: Sanitize reason at write time (strip HTML tags). Enforce max length of 1000 characters. Never render audit history via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

findings.title: Body Parser Returns 500 Instead of 413 on Oversized Payload
findings.remediation: Set app.use(express.json({ limit: '50kb' })) explicitly. Add PayloadTooLargeError handler in errorHandler.ts returning HTTP 413. Add per-field length validation: title ≤ 255, description ≤ 5000, reason ≤ 1000.

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.remediation: npm install cors @types/cors; app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') })) with an explicit allowlist. Default deny-all except known origins.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS-terminating reverse proxy requirement in deployment docs. Add env-var check on startup. Add HSTS via helmet.hsts({ maxAge: 31536000 }).

findings.title: No Hard-Delete / GDPR Right to Erasure
findings.remediation: Add hardDelete(id) to the store. Expose as an admin-only endpoint. Purge changeHistory entries referencing the deleted item.

findings.title: Sequential Predictable DocIDs — Enumeration Oracle
findings.remediation: Replace sequential counter with a random or time-based prefix. Persist the counter to prevent restart-based docId collisions.

findings.title: Dockerfile Runs as Root (portal/Dockerfile)
findings.remediation: Add RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup and USER appuser before CMD/ENTRYPOINT.

findings.title: Vite Dev Server Binds to 0.0.0.0 in Docker
findings.remediation: For production: build to static bundle and serve via nginx. Never bind dev servers to 0.0.0.0 in production or shared environments.

findings.title: iframe Missing sandbox Attribute (DebugPortalPage)
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the iframe element. Evaluate minimum required permissions.

findings.title: Raw Exception Messages Returned to Clients in Workflow Routes
findings.remediation: Remove inline 500 handlers returning err.message. Let errors propagate to central errorHandler.ts. Add lint rule to prohibit res.status(500).json({ error: err.message }) patterns.

findings.title: Stack Traces Logged at Server Level (Production Risk)
findings.remediation: Gate stack trace logging on NODE_ENV: log full stacks in development, log only err.message in production. Ensure log aggregator access is role-gated.

findings.title: Unimplemented /api/search Endpoint — Future Attack Surface
findings.remediation: When implementing: use safe string-comparison search (not user-controlled regex), paginate results (max 100), apply authentication. Fuzz with ReDoS payloads before release.
